item.title: Apogee Eczema Drug Zumilokibart
item.description:
• Summary: Apogee Therapeutics announced a $1.3 billion royalty financing deal with Blackstone to advance its investigational eczema drug zumilokibart into Phase 3 trials. Zumilokibart, a monoclonal antibody targeting IL-13, has shown efficacy comparable to Ebglyss (lebrikizumab) from Eli Lilly in earlier studies. The deal has sparked mixed investor reactions, with some concerned about the royalty burden, but the funding is critical for the late-stage program. The drug is positioned as a potential competitor to Dupixent (dupilumab) in atopic dermatitis.
  • MoAs: IL-13 antagonist (monoclonal antibody targeting interleukin-13)
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, BioSpace, Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech
